text: Nine lakh cows, it is said. And today, a little boy would lead them all.
Until now, Nanda had only let young Krishna look after the calves. He's too small for the big cows, everyone said.
But Krishna begged and begged. Baba, let me take the whole herd to the forest!
So Nanda asked the priest to choose a perfect day. He chose the eighth day of the bright moon, in the month of Kartik.
That morning, Krishna and his brother Balarama led the herd out of Vrindavan for the very first time.
And when he played his flute, every single cow followed.
That day is still celebrated as Gopashtami. Care for the small things, and bigger ones will be trusted to you.
